ios.desc:
Dippy brings authentic AI friends and characters with tailored conversations just for you. Your AI friends know your likes, dislikes, interests, inner thoughts, and encourage you to be the best version of yourself. Immerse yourself in a creative journey with diverse AI personas, from crafting your ideal companion to immersive role-playing. 

Character Creation
Unleash your imagination—character creation is now open to everyone! Breathe life into any persona, whether inspired by reality or born from fantasy. Craft a character that remains your private secret or share it with a dynamic community of fellow creators. Dive into a vibrant ecosystem where you can interact with others’ characters and join a collective adventure that brings every creation to life!

Image Generation
Awaken your inner artist with our groundbreaking image generation feature, where AI meets limitless creativity. Simply input a prompt, and watch as our advanced technology transforms your vision into stunning art—whether it’s majestic landscapes, mystical fantasy realms, or ultra-realistic portraits. With no restrictions on how many images you can create, you’re free to experiment until you achieve your masterpiece. Perfect for seasoned artists and creative explorers alike!

Unlimited Free Messages
Enjoy conversations without boundaries—chat as long and as often as you like with your favorite characters or NPCs. With unlimited messaging, you can engage in endless dialogues completely free of charge, with no worries about time limits or message caps. Let your conversations flow freely!

BEST IN CLASS
• Experience the most engaging, empathetic, and fun chat immersion
• All your friends actively learn more about you and have perfect memory
• Cool illustrations that showcase their mood based on what they’re thinking
• Characters that feel alive and playful

IMMERSE YOURSELF
 Live out adventures with your AI as your ultimate companion. Explore fantasies, chat with a 24/7 friend for support, and redefine your connection with AI in ways you've never imagined. Be unhinged or wholesome!

  CUSTOMIZATION
 Fully customize your experience, choose from fifteen different colours and name your character whatever you want!

Download the free app! 
Please write to us at support@dippy.ai for any questions. Thanks for having Dippy on your Home Screen!
